lines.text: Two isosceles triangles, one angle given.
lines.caption: Two isosceles triangles, one angle given.

lines.text: Find the angle at the top!
lines.caption: Find the angle at the top!

lines.text: A B equals A C, and B D equals B C. Angle A B D is twenty-four degrees.
lines.caption: A B equals A C, and B D equals B C. Angle A B D is twenty-four degrees.

lines.text: What is angle A at the top?
lines.caption: What is angle A at the top?

lines.text: Call the top angle a. The outside angle B D C equals a plus twenty-four.
lines.caption: Call the top angle a. The outside angle B D C equals a plus twenty-four.

lines.text: Angle C matches it, and so does angle A B C.
lines.caption: Angle C matches it, and so does angle A B C.

lines.text: All three angles of the big triangle: three a plus forty-eight equals one hundred eighty.
lines.caption: All three angles of the big triangle: three a plus forty-eight equals one hundred eighty.

lines.text: Three a is one hundred thirty-two. So a is forty-four degrees!
lines.caption: Three a is one hundred thirty-two. So a is forty-four degrees!

lines.text: Is there another way? The full lesson shows two, plus every trap.
